notes.title: 「Shutter Nyan! Enhanced Edition」 Update Announcement (October 20, 2022)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36634752/3135143eaa440c1ae2f31a74ac1320e22ce5ef80.jpg[/img]

Hello, this is CFK.

As of today(Thursday, October 20), 「Shutter Nyang」 has been updated to 「Shutter Nyan! Enhanced Edition」!

「Shutter Nyan! Enhanced Edition」 is a powered up version of the original 「Shutter Nyang」, featuring quality of life modifications including difficulty balancing patches, in-game tutorials and other various elements that make the gameplay more convenient.

Following the Nintendo Switch version's release, the Steam version has also been updated. Players who already purchased the original 「Shutter Nyang」 can embark on another enjoyable adventure in 「Shutter Nyan! Enhanced Edition」 for free.

Also, don't miss the special 10% discount offered until Thursday, October 27! Join us and celebrate the game's official update.

As always, thank you so much for your interest and support. We will keep doing our best to meet your expectations.

notes.title: Assist Mode Update and Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello! Dear Nyang Butlers, Shutter Nyang V 1.1.4 patch is up.
We included an ‘Assist Mode’ to make the game difficulty more easier.

[h1][b]New Feature: Assist Mode[/b][/h1]
 - If you activate the mod, the photo will not be deleted even when taking damage. And the photo duration time will be doubled.
 - When you start the game, you will be asked if you want to activate ‘Assist Mode’.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36634752/ad103d5806685262d5d8a0d15eff8582e7ba5387.png[/img]

 - ‘Assist Mode’ can be activated at any time from the ESC window.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36634752/63f76af89f8fc46204504ac940520c7363ba86a0.png[/img]

 - Once you activate ‘Assist Mode’, you can not deactivate it unless you start a new game.

[h1][b]Bug patch[/b][/h1]
 - Now the path to Chapter 1 does not appear before the player gets the camera.
 - Some pad UI that did not appear is fixed.

[h1][b]Translation patch[/b][/h1]
 - Added Japanese and Chinese translations related to Slow Motion.

notes.title: Shutter Nyang V1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
This patch was also in the direction of adjusting the game difficulty. In particular, the difficulty of the second stage boss, which became the refund stage, has been greatly modified.

The details of Shutter Nyang V1.0.3 patch are as follows.

[b]Bug fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed save and respawn problems. (Problem was players do not respawn at the save point when dying while stepping on a certain part of the spring.)
[*] Fixed environment resetting problems. (Problem was broken terrain and doors were not resetted if you pressed ESC during the game and restart the stage with ‘Restart’)
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Modified the level design of some stages.
[*] Deleted some obstacles and enemies, increased enemy respawn time, added some terrain
[/list]

notes.title: Shutter Nyang V1.0.1 Patch Details
notes.notes:
Bug Fix
Fixed certain situations in which the game could not be played.
Fixed graphics related issues.
Fixed sound related issue. (Sound problems occur when a poster is placed on the poster board repeatedly)

Improvements
Improved viewpoints. (With the camera function active, you can freely change the viewpoint up or down)
Improved Save system. (If you reenter a stage, the broken object will remain broken except boss battles. Save progress before this patch is not applied)
Improved enemies. (Fixed a problem where enemies were not attracted when a picture of a cat is placed in a frame on a certain wall)
Improved way finding. (After clearing the chapter, the arrow indicating the path does not disappear. In addition, the arrow shape has been improved to facilitate navigation)
Improved UI. (A map-shaped icon has been added to the checkpoint to intuitively show ‘view map’ function)
Improved localization. (Chinese&Japnese localization has been improved)

Note: If you apply the Shutter Nyang demo save file to the full version, the game will not proceed properly.

notes.title: The developers behind 'Shutter Nyang', indie game studio 'PROJECT MOREUM'.
notes.notes:
[h1]'Pleasure from Unknown'[/h1]
('MOREUM' means 'Unknown', 'Uncertainty' in  Korean)

Project Moreum is the indie game studio established by 4 game enthusiasts. Studio's main goal is to imagine unknown realms filled with adventures and express them in the form of games.

'Shutter Nyang' is our first game to express our motto.
It is challenging Platformer Action game. The players play as the ‘Cat’ whom got separated from his friend, a little girl. Using mystical camera, create your own unique imagination to help the ‘Cat’ get back to his friend.
